paymentMethods.title: Payoneer Email Transfer
instructions: Log in to your Payoneer Account or Mobile App.
Navigate to Pay → Make a Payment.
Enter payable amount in USD/EUR with order reference.
Upload payment receipt screenshot / TxID below for instant handover.

paymentMethods.title: Binance Pay Direct
instructions: Go to Pay → Send -> Select Pay ID.
Confirm payment amount & submit screenshot proof below.

paymentMethods.title: USDT Tron Network
instructions: Send exact USDT amount from your wallet/exchange (Binance, Bybit, KuCoin, TrustWallet).
Paste Transaction Hash (TxID) below after sending.

paymentMethods.title: USDT BNB Smart Chain
instructions: Select BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) in your crypto wallet.
Submit TxID and screenshot proof below for fast confirmation.

paymentMethods.title: Binance Pay QR Code Scanner
instructions: Tap the QR Code Scanner icon in top right.
Scan the QR code to auto-populate merchant details and complete payment.

paymentMethods.title: Merchant API Key Integration
instructions: Enter Binance Merchant API Key and Secret Key for local automated callback verification.
